Quantum 1.39.0 was certified on 2026-10-05. It pins **nucleus v1.31.0**, **quark v1.15.2** and **orbit v1.18.1**, with 25 sibling modules.

A minor release of the suite after Quantum 1.38.0: nucleus goes from v1.30.1 to v1.31.0 (minor), quark goes from v1.15.0 to v1.15.2 (patch) and orbit goes from v1.18.0 to v1.18.1 (patch). 22 sibling modules change version.
